name: q
label: Search text
help: Words of the name. Each word matches part of it.

name: prefix
label: Folder
help: Search inside this folder and its subfolders. Choose a bucket first.

name: kind
label: Kind
help: Leave it empty for every kind.

name: extension
label: Extensions
help: File extensions without the dot, for example `pdf`.

name: labelIds
label: Labels
help: Only files that have every one of these labels.

name: sizeMin
label: Minimum size (bytes)
help: Only files of at least this size, in bytes.

name: sizeMax
label: Maximum size (bytes)
help: Only files of at most this size, in bytes.

name: modifiedFrom
label: Modified from
help: Only items modified on or after this date.

name: modifiedTo
label: Modified to
help: Only items modified on or before this date.

name: sort
label: Sort by
help: With search text, better matches come first and this setting orders each group.

name: order
label: Order
help: Leave it empty to sort names from A to Z and dates from newest to oldest.

name: includeHidden
label: Include hidden items
help: Also find items hidden in Nubbo.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: The maximum number of results to be worked with during one execution cycle.
